description: Image microtomographiques de matériaux composites de type Glass Fiber Reinforced Poymer (GFRP) à plusieurs couches impactés (Machine Learning) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by IRL 2958 Georgia Tech - CNRS. Description globale: Ce jeu de données présente l'ensemble des images obtenues par tomographie aux rayons X de matériaux composites de type Glass Fiber Reinforced Polymer (GFRP) à 4 couches tissées. Coverage: IRL 2958 Georgia Tech - CNRS. The publisher named on the listing is IRL 2958 Georgia Tech - CNRS. Its keywords include materiaux, microtomographie, tests-non-destructifs, machine-learning, donnees-ouvertes. The listing shows 4 download or service links in 003, 002, 001, 004. The listing shows 2026-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
